config_fields.name: host
config_fields.help: API host: partner.shopeemobile.com (global production), openplatform.shopee.cn (mainland China), openplatform.shopee.com.br (Brazil) or openplatform.sandbox.test-stable.shopee.sg (sandbox).

fields.name: partner_id
fields.help: partner_id of your Shopee Open Platform app (Console > App list).

fields.name: partner_key
fields.help: The app's partner_key; signs the refresh request and every call (lower-case hex HMAC-SHA256) and is never sent.

fields.name: shop_id
fields.help: shop_id that authorised the app (returned in the authorisation redirect).

fields.name: refresh_token
fields.help: The shop's refresh_token from v2.public.get_access_token (valid 30 days, single-use). Each refresh (every ~4 h) returns a new one that replaces it (persisted when PLATFORM_MCP_STATE_DIR is set).

me.note: v2.shop.get_shop_info: shop_name, region, status, is_cb, auth_time and expire_time of the shop authorisation.

list_products.note: v2.product.get_item_list: the shop's own NORMAL (live) listings — ids, status and update_time only (the API returns no titles or prices; call get_product per id). `query`/`category` are not applied. Seller-side channel API.

get_product.note: v2.product.get_item_base_info: name, description, SKU, price_info (current/original price, currency), images, weight/dimensions and logistic_info of one listing (items with variations carry prices on their models).

get_order.note: v2.order.get_order_detail for one order_sn: order_status (UNPAID, READY_TO_SHIP, PROCESSED, SHIPPED, COMPLETED, …), total_amount, currency, epoch-second times and item_list in raw.

track.note: v2.logistics.get_tracking_info: logistics_status and the tracking_info events [{update_time, description, logistics_status}] of an order's package (split orders need the package_number, not supported here).

not_offered.quote_shipping: Shopee is a sales channel: shipping fees are charged to buyers at checkout; the logistics APIs (e.g. https://open.shopee.com/documents/v2/v2.logistics.get_tracking_info?module=89&type=1) fulfil existing orders and do not quote shipping for a product and country.
not_offered.create_order: Orders are placed by Shopee buyers; the Order module (https://open.shopee.com/documents/v2/v2.order.get_order_detail?module=89&type=1) reads and ships them and has no create call.

adapter.terms: Shopee Open Platform v2 (https://open.shopee.com/developer-guide/20): shop APIs carry partner_id, timestamp, access_token, shop_id and sign = hex HMAC-SHA256(partner_key, partner_id + api path + timestamp + access_token + shop_id); access tokens last 4 h and are refreshed by the signed v2.public.refresh_access_token (JSON {refresh_token, partner_id, shop_id}); authorisations last at most 365 days.

evidence: host partner.shopeemobile.com: DNS ok, TLSv1.3 (Let's Encrypt)
